records.title: From Synapses to Dynamics: Obtaining Function from Structure in a Connectome Constrained Model of the Head Direction Circuit

decisions.notes: Primary bioRxiv v1 JATS sections 2.2, 4.1-4.2 and 5.1-5.4: 439 adult head-direction neurons from the hemibrain connectome, 57 optimized cell-type parameters, self-supervised rate dynamics and in-silico cell-type ablations; Supplemental Methods sections A.1-A.8 checked. No new animal recordings, larval nociception, human ECAP, SCS, or clinical outcome. Multiple viable parameter solutions do not establish calibrated uncertainty outside this simulation. Field resolutions use terminal not_reported states and primary locators.
